text: Assumption: Errors are signaled in ara::core::Result — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Errors are signaled in ara::core::Result — is this correct?
norm: errors are signaled in ara core result
rationale: SWS_DM_00822 defines calling when isActivationLineDependent = TRUE as an error, but does not name any standardized error codes, which is why signaling likely occurs via implementation-specific error codes in ara::core::Result.

original.text: Annahme: Fehlersignalisierung im Result — trifft das zu?
